acceptanceRequirement: The real capture worker must emit an image plus schema-v3 JSON sidecar with camera, cup_zone, cup_event_id, captured_at_utc, image_sha256, zone geometry, and zone configuration hash. Recovered recording frames remain manager-review evidence and never become sales, deliveries, inventory changes, or automatic capture successes.
